audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was described as 'he chooses every trade' with no cooldowns on either of the two abilities that let him do it.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike is 10/9.25/8.5/7.75/7 and Crushing Blow 8/7.5/7/6.5/6. Those are the numbers that decide whether you can step up for a CS, and neither appeared anywhere in the entry.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns added to the level 2-3 spike, the early text and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first-item spikes said to go 'while his W clone is on cooldown' and 'his R isn't up' with no timers.
audit.why: Warrior Trickster is 22/21/20/19/18 and Cyclone is 130/110/90. At rank 1 those are a 22-second and a 130-second window — big enough to plan around, and meaningless as 'on cooldown'.
audit.corrected: Both spikes now carry the rank-1 numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid said dropping Shroud on his E-in makes 'his follow-up Q whiff and you break true-sight' — a vague claim that misses the actual interaction. Stone Skin was described as bonus resists 'near enemies'.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike dashes to a TARGETED enemy. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected by enemy spells, so inside the smoke the dash cannot be cast on you at all — that is a hard denial, not a whiff. Stone Skin stacks armour and max-health regeneration while he is fighting champions and monsters, which is a combat condition rather than a proximity aura.
audit.corrected: Shroud lines now state the targeted dash cannot select you; Stone Skin described as stacking while he fights.

edits.before: Wukong's Q (Crushing Blow) shreds your armor and his E gap-close lets him pick every short trade before you have Shroud or your passive ring set up.
edits.after: Wukong's Crushing Blow (Q) shreds your armour on an 8s attack reset, and Nimbus Strike (E) picks every short trade before you have Shroud.

edits.before: Your one window: R dash-in plus the missing-HP re-dash, chained off E, out-bursts him while his W clone is on cooldown and his R isn't up yet — force the all-in here.
edits.after: Your one window: R dash-in plus the missing-HP re-dash, chained off E, out-bursts him while Warrior Trickster is down — 22s at rank 1 — and Cyclone isn't up yet.

edits.before: Your first AP spike roughly evens it, but his R (Cyclone) knockup can still interrupt your second R re-dash mid-combo.
edits.after: Your first AP spike roughly evens it, but Cyclone's knockup, 130s at rank 1, still interrupts your second R re-dash.

edits.before: Wukong builds bruiser HP and his passive bonus resists near enemies blunt your single-target burst, while his R knockup flips fights your kit can't brawl through.
edits.after: Wukong builds bruiser HP and Stone Skin stacks armour and health regen while he fights, blunting your burst, while Cyclone's knockup flips fights you can't brawl.

edits.before: Bait his W clone — wait for the real Wukong to commit before you spend E and your R
edits.after: Bait his Warrior Trickster clone — wait for the real Wukong before you spend E and R

edits.before: Hit Level 6 even, then all-in with R-into-E burst while his W clone and R (Cyclone) are down
edits.after: Hit Level 6, then all-in with R-into-E burst while Warrior Trickster and Cyclone are down

edits.before: Dodge your E with his E dash or fake you out with the W clone, then re-engage on his terms
edits.after: Dash Nimbus Strike onto you or fake you out with the clone, then re-engage on his terms

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his — Wukong's Q (Crushing Blow) shreds your armor and adds bonus damage, and his E dash means he chooses every trade while you have no Shroud and no R. Do not throw Q (Five Point Strike) at him point-blank to push, because he just E's in, lands his armor-shred Q, and walks out before you can cross your passive ring for an empowered auto. Last-hit at max Q range, eat minimal poke, and respect that his W clone will pop out to bait your step-up.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his — Crushing Blow (Q) shreds your armour on an 8s attack reset, and Nimbus Strike (E) at 10s means he chooses every trade while you have no Shroud and no R. Do not throw Q (Five Point Strike) at him point-blank to push, because he just dashes in, lands the armour-shred, and walks out before you cross your passive ring for an empowered attack. Last-hit at max Q range, eat minimal poke, and respect that his clone will pop out to bait your step-up.

edits.before: Once you have Shroud at 4-5 you can finally reset a trade he starts — drop W on his E-in so his follow-up Q whiffs and you break true-sight. But he still out-stats you here, so play for your one real window: Level 6. Your R first dash plus the missing-HP execute re-dash, chained off E, is the only thing that out-bursts a Wukong who has already burned his W clone and doesn't have R (Cyclone) back up. Bait the clone, wait for the real one, then all-in — that combo is your whole lane.
edits.after: Once you have Shroud at 4-5 you can finally reset a trade he starts — and the reason it works is mechanical: Nimbus Strike dashes to a targeted enemy, so inside the smoke he cannot select you and the dash simply will not cast. But he still out-stats you here, so play for your one real window: Level 6. Your R first dash plus the missing-HP execute re-dash, chained off E, out-bursts a Wukong who has burned Warrior Trickster and has no Cyclone. Bait the clone, wait for the real one, then all-in.

edits.before: His Q (Crushing Blow) shreds your armor and his E dash dictates every trade — you have only Q and no Shroud to answer pre-3.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds your armour on an 8s reset and Nimbus Strike dictates every trade — you have only Q and no Shroud pre-3.

edits.before: He out-trades you in the 4-5 window even after Shroud — his sustained Q damage beats your reset-and-poke pattern.
edits.after: He out-trades you at 4-5 even after Shroud — though Nimbus Strike must select you, so the smoke denies the dash.

edits.before: He out-scales you — bruiser HP and passive resists near enemies shrug off your burst while his R knockup wrecks fights.
edits.after: He out-scales you — bruiser HP and Stone Skin's stacking armour shrug off your burst while Cyclone's knockup wrecks fights.

edits.before: His Q shreds you — shroud his E-Q, Q-poke. Akali wins the Nimbus Strike cooldown windows.
edits.after: His Q shreds you — Shroud denies the targeted E. Akali wins the Nimbus Strike gaps.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His engage dash. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wukong Nimbus Strike, 10s at rank 1: matchup-defining — it must SELECT you, so Shroud denies the dash. - Crushing Blow, 8s: an attack reset that shreds armour. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage dash. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A targeted dash, 10s at rank 1 — inside Shroud it cannot select you.

notes: The decisive interaction was present but unexplained: Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so Twilight Shroud denies it outright rather than merely making his follow-up whiff. The old mid text justified the shroud with 'you break true-sight', which is not a mechanic in either kit. No cooldowns appeared anywhere in this entry before this pass.
